ideaBank.title: Normal Curve Playground

ideaBank.title: Projectile Planner

ideaBank.title: Spring and Wave (SHM)
ideaBank.detail: Mass on a spring traces a sine wave.

ideaBank.title: Loan Calculator
ideaBank.detail: Compound interest and EMI; graph of balance (math + economics).

gameIdeas.title: Fruit Basket Count
gameIdeas.detail: drag fruits into a basket, tap each to count aloud 1-10. Picture: big fruits, number pops up. Pip points and counts with every fruit.

gameIdeas.title: Number Train
gameIdeas.detail: trains have empty wagons; drag the missing number (1-20). Picture: coloured train. Pip flies along the track.

gameIdeas.title: Shape Hunt
gameIdeas.detail: tap all circles/squares/triangles hidden in a play room scene. Picture: toys, windows, plates. Pip circles the shape with the crayon.

gameIdeas.title: Big & Small Balance
gameIdeas.detail: put two objects on a see-saw; pick which is bigger, more, fewer. Picture: animals on the see-saw.

gameIdeas.title: Bead Pattern
gameIdeas.detail: continue a red-blue-red-blue string by dragging beads. Pip taps the rhythm of the pattern.

gameIdeas.title: Colour Sort Garden
gameIdeas.detail: drop flowers/objects in the matching pot. Pip says the colour name, then the student repeats.

gameIdeas.title: Fraction Pizza Shop (EXAMPLE FILE: game.html)
gameIdeas.detail: customer orders a fraction like 3/4; student taps slices. Bolt shows top/bottom number. Later levels: equivalent fractions, compare two pizzas.

gameIdeas.title: Ten-Frame Add-Up
gameIdeas.detail: drop counters in a ten-frame to make sums within 10 and 20; subtraction by removing counters.

gameIdeas.title: Block Builder (place value)
gameIdeas.detail: build a number using hundred/ten/one blocks; trade 10 ones for 1 ten. Bolt explains regrouping.

gameIdeas.title: Clock Cafe
gameIdeas.detail: move the clock hands to the time on the order slip; later: how long until the cake is ready (elapsed time).

gameIdeas.title: Taka Shop
gameIdeas.detail: pay the exact price with coins/notes, then give change. Currency shown in Taka.

gameIdeas.title: Flower Array
gameIdeas.detail: plant rows x columns to see multiplication as equal groups; swap rows and columns to see 3x4 = 4x3.

gameIdeas.title: Bake-Sale Graph
gameIdeas.detail: tally sales, drag bars to build a bar graph, then answer "which sold most / how many more?"

gameIdeas.title: Pet Fence
gameIdeas.detail: drag fence pieces around a field; count squares for area and fence length for perimeter.

gameIdeas.title: Smoothie Ratio Mixer
gameIdeas.detail: keep a recipe ratio when serving more people; unit rate = cost of 1 glass. Visual: glasses fill with colour.

gameIdeas.title: Basement Lift
gameIdeas.detail: a lift moves above/below ground; add and subtract integers as moves on a vertical number line.

gameIdeas.title: Balance Scale Equations
gameIdeas.detail: keep the scale level while adding/removing equal weights to solve one- and two-step equations.

gameIdeas.title: Factor Tree Forest
gameIdeas.detail: split a number into prime leaves; use the leaves to find GCF and LCM.

gameIdeas.title: Ramp Designer
gameIdeas.detail: drag a ramp's height and run; slope number updates; match the ramp to a given slope.

gameIdeas.title: Ladder Rescue (Pythagoras)
gameIdeas.detail: ladder against a wall; squares grow on each side to prove a2 + b2 = c2; find the safe ladder length.

gameIdeas.title: Hoop Shot (quadratics)
gameIdeas.detail: change a, h, k sliders so the ball's parabola passes through hoops; roots = where it lands.

gameIdeas.title: Function Factory
gameIdeas.detail: a machine turns inputs into outputs; guess the rule, then chain two machines (composition), find domain/range.

gameIdeas.title: Treasure Map Systems
gameIdeas.detail: two clue lines cross at the treasure; solve by graph, then check by substitution/elimination.

gameIdeas.title: Proof Builder
gameIdeas.detail: drag reason cards (SAS, ASA, CPCTC) into a two-column proof for triangle congruence.

gameIdeas.title: Tower Surveyor (trigonometry)
gameIdeas.detail: choose sin, cos or tan to find the height of a tower from a given angle and distance.

gameIdeas.title: Grow or Fade
gameIdeas.detail: compare linear vs exponential (savings, medicine, virus); slide the rate and watch both graphs.

gameIdeas.title: Unit Circle Spinner
gameIdeas.detail: drag a point round the circle; see angle in degrees and radians and sin/cos drawn as a live wave.

gameIdeas.title: Limit Zoom Lens
gameIdeas.detail: zoom into a graph near a point; numbers from left and right close in; spot jumps and holes (continuity).

gameIdeas.title: Slope Tracker (derivative)
gameIdeas.detail: a tangent line rides the curve and its slope draws the derivative graph in a second panel.

gameIdeas.title: Box Optimiser
gameIdeas.detail: cut corners of a sheet to fold a box; slider finds the maximum volume; link to derivative = 0.

gameIdeas.title: Rain Rectangles (integrals)
gameIdeas.detail: add more rectangles under a curve and watch the sum approach the exact area.

gameIdeas.title: Matrix Transformer
gameIdeas.detail: a 2x2 matrix reshapes a picture; determinant = area scale; try to undo it with the inverse. target: "3/4", selected: 2, tries: 1 } context. interactionTemplates.title: DRAG-TO-BUILD
interactionTemplates.detail: Student drags blocks/pieces into a frame to make a target amount. Used for: counting, place value, fractions, area tiles, equations. Check: sum of placed pieces equals target.

interactionTemplates.title: SLIDER EXPLORER
interactionTemplates.detail: One or more sliders change a picture or graph live. A readout shows the numbers. Prompt: "Move it. What stays the same? What changes?" Check: optional mini-question after exploring ("Make the slope 3").

interactionTemplates.title: COMPARE THREE REPRESENTATIONS
interactionTemplates.detail: Same idea shown as picture, table, graph, words. Student matches or ranks. Check: matches and ranking correct.

interactionTemplates.title: PREDICT, THEN RUN
interactionTemplates.detail: Student commits to a guess, presses Run, an animation reveals the truth, then the screen shows the gap between guess and result. Used for: races, probability, rates, motion.

interactionTemplates.title: TAP-TO-SORT / SORTING BINS
interactionTemplates.detail: Items fall; student drags into bins (even/odd, shape type, prime/not). Check: all items binned. Reveal rule at end.

interactionTemplates.title: NUMBER LINE HOP
interactionTemplates.detail: A character hops along a line. Student sets jump size and count. Used for: addition, subtraction, integers, multiplication, fractions.

interactionTemplates.title: BALANCE SCALE
interactionTemplates.detail: Two pans with objects/unknown boxes. Student adds/removes the SAME thing from both sides. Used for: equal sign, equations, inequalities.

interactionTemplates.title: DRAW-IT-YOURSELF (trace / plot)
interactionTemplates.detail: Student traces a shape, plots points, or draws a line through points. Check: tolerance-based (within X pixels). Line art style shines here.

interactionTemplates.title: FIND-THE-MISTAKE
interactionTemplates.detail: A worked solution with one wrong line. Student taps the bad line. Check: correct line chosen; then explains why in a choice list.

interactionTemplates.title: CONSTRUCT & MEASURE
interactionTemplates.detail: Student drags vertices/points; app shows angles, lengths, area live. Check: "Make a triangle with area 12" within tolerance.

interactionTemplates.title: DATA PLAYGROUND
interactionTemplates.detail: Student drags dots on a dot plot / bars on a chart. Mean, median, spread update live. Used for: statistics from Class 3 to Class 12.

interactionTemplates.title: SIMULATE MANY TIMES
interactionTemplates.detail: Button "Run 1 / 10 / 100 / 1000 times" shows results piling up as a graph. Used for: probability, randomness, distributions.

interactionTemplates.title: STORY PROBLEM WITH A PICTURE ENGINE
interactionTemplates.detail: A short local story (bazar, school bus, river, cricket) generated from a template with random numbers, solved with a built-in tool. Check: numeric input with accepted tolerance or unit handling.
